description.zh: 在百度网盘和素材库之间搬文件。拉:用 pan_list 或 pan_search 找到 fs_id,再用 pan_import 导进来。传:用 pan_upload 把素材库里的东西存到网盘(传 asset_id 和目标路径)。
description.en: Move files between Baidu Netdisk and the asset library. To pull: find an fs_id with pan_list or pan_search, then bring it in with pan_import. To push: use pan_upload to save something from the asset library to the netdisk (pass an asset_id and a target path).

description.zh: 把一个现成的 MCP server 接成 Mosael 插件的范例。工具清单由 server 自己提供,不写在这个文件里。
description.en: An example of wiring an existing MCP server up as an Mosael plugin. The tool list comes from the server itself, not from this file.

description.zh: 文本小工具:统计字数、提取话题标签、生成标题候选。纯本地计算,无需任何权限。
description.en: Small text utilities: count words, pull out hashtags, draft title candidates. All local, no permissions needed.

description.zh: 读抖音 / TikTok / 小红书 / B站 / 快手等平台的公开数据:作品详情、作者主页与作品列表、关键词搜索、热榜。用于选题调研、对标账号分析、找素材灵感。
description.en: Read public data from Douyin / TikTok / Xiaohongshu / Bilibili / Kuaishou and other platforms: post details, creator profiles and their posts, keyword search, trending charts. For topic research, studying comparable accounts, and finding footage ideas.
